title: Fake Event Ticket Abroad
scenario: A seller near the venue offers digital tickets and wants instant transfer.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Fake Event Ticket Abroad: the trap is to turn convenience into a device or network security risk. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Use official ticket transfer or box office verification.
